launcher.label: Ask
launcher.shortcut: Ask the assistant (Ctrl or Cmd + Shift + L)

panel.title: Ask the assistant
panel.subtitle: Say what you want to do. I read this page and click for you, and I ask before anything is saved, sent, deleted or paid.
panel.taskLabel: What do you want to do?
panel.taskPlaceholder: For example: add the tag VIP to a contact
panel.disabledHere: The assistant is off on this screen because it shows messages and details written by customers. Open another screen to use it.

notice.title: Before you start
notice.sent: To do a task, the assistant sends your request and the text of the page you are on to an AI provider.
notice.masked: Phone numbers, e-mail addresses and secrets are hidden first. Names and other text on the page are not.
notice.asks: It uses your own account, so it can only do what you can do. It asks you before it saves, sends, deletes, pays, invites people or changes settings.
notice.limits: It never types passwords or card details, never opens other websites, and you can stop it at any moment.

confirm.title: Allow this?
confirm.clickBody: The assistant is about to click "{label}".
confirm.selectBody: The assistant is about to choose "{detail}" in "{label}".

reasons.marked: This is one of the most sensitive buttons in the app.
reasons.submit: This saves or submits what is on the page.
reasons.delete: This deletes, removes or disconnects something.
reasons.send: This sends, publishes or starts something others will see.
reasons.pay: This may spend money or change what you pay.
reasons.invite: This invites someone to your workspace.
reasons.connect: This connects or disconnects a channel or an app.
reasons.access: This changes who can do what, or a secret or billing detail.
reasons.settings: This turns something on or off.
reasons.toggle: This switch takes effect at once.
reasons.dialog: This confirms what the window is asking.

result.summary: {steps, plural, one {# step} other {# steps}}, {confirmed} allowed, {denied} declined.

stopped.budget: The task reached its step limit and stopped. Try a smaller request.
stopped.location: The task stopped because it reached a screen the assistant is not allowed to use.

errors.disabled: The assistant is turned off for this workspace or on this screen.
errors.planLocked: The assistant is not part of your plan.
errors.forbidden: You do not have permission to use the assistant.
errors.rateLimited: Too many requests. Wait a moment and try again.
errors.taskLimit: You have started as many tasks as are allowed for now. Try again later.
errors.stepLimit: This task used up its steps. Start a new one with a smaller request.
errors.closed: This task has ended. Start a new one.
errors.providerDown: The AI service did not answer. Try again in a moment, or ask the platform owner if it keeps happening.
errors.monthlyLimit: Your workspace has used this month's AI allowance.
errors.signedOut: Your session ended. Sign in again.
errors.network: Could not reach the server. Check your connection and try again.

examples.showMe: Show me where to start in {title}
examples.generic1: How do I connect my WhatsApp number?
examples.generic2: Where do I change my business profile?
examples.generic3: How do I invite a teammate?

helpCard.title: Ask the assistant
helpCard.body: Tell it what you want to do. It finds the right guide, shows you where to click, or does the steps for you and asks before anything important.

settingsPage.title: Help assistant
settingsPage.description: Let your team ask for what they want to do and have the app guide them or do the steps on their own account.
settingsPage.loadFailed: The setting could not be loaded.
settingsPage.shareTitle: What is shared when someone uses it
settingsPage.share1: The request the person typed, and the visible text of the page they are on, are sent to the AI provider the platform uses.
settingsPage.share2: Phone numbers, e-mail addresses, secrets and the personal fields of forms are hidden first. Names and other free text on a page are not.
settingsPage.share3: Customer messages and team chat are never read: the assistant is off on those screens.
settingsPage.share4: The assistant acts with the signed-in person's own permissions and asks before it saves, sends, deletes, pays or changes settings. Only counts and the outcome of each task are stored, never the request text.
settingsPage.optIn: By turning it on you confirm your workspace agrees to share this with the AI provider.
settingsPage.switchLabel: Turn on the Help assistant for this workspace
settingsPage.stateOn: On. People with the permission see the Ask button.
settingsPage.saveFailed: The setting could not be saved.
settingsPage.whoCanUse: Only roles with the permission "Use the Help assistant" see it. Owners and admins have it.
